This study aimed to assess perceptions, knowledge, attitudes, and implementation preferences related to AASP among veterinary students and teaching staff from a Romanian Faculty of Veterinary Medicine. papers.title: Xuebijing alleviates acute hydrogen sulfide-induced pyroptosis in rat spleen via suppression of the caspase-1/NLRP3 pathway.
papers.authors: Ding L, Han Y, Chen Y, Zou H, Ma Y
papers.abstract: Hydrogen sulfide (H2S) is a pervasive environmental toxicant with well-established immunotoxic effects. However, its action on lymphoid organs-particularly whether it triggers splenic pyroptosis-remains elusive. This study explored the effect of acute H2S exposure on rat spleen and the therapeutic potential of Xuebijing (XBJ), a traditional Chinese medicine for sepsis.
